subject: general
question:
A cylindrical rod has an outer curved surface area of 1300 cm². If the length of the rod is 60 cm, then the outer radius (in cm) of the rod, correct to two places of decimal, is:

{Take } pi = (22)/(7)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Radius (r) = CSA ÷ (2 × π × h)

Given CSA = 1300, h = 60, π = 22/7

r = 1300 ÷ (2 × 22/7 × 60)

r = (1300 × 7) ÷ (2 × 22 × 60)

r = 455 ÷ 132 ≈ 3.45 cm

**∴ Answer = 3.45**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Curved Surface Area (CSA) = 1300 cm²

Length of the rod (h) = 60 cm

π = 22/7

**Formula used:**

Curved Surface Area (CSA) = 2 × π × r × h

 
• 
• 
• r = ? 
• h = 60 cm CSA = 1300 Radius ≈ 3.45 cm 

**Calculations:**

CSA = 2 × π × r × h

⇒ 1300 = 2 × (22/7) × r × 60

⇒ 1300 = (2640 ÷ 7) × r

⇒ r = (1300 × 7) ÷ 2640

⇒ r = 9100 ÷ 2640

⇒ r = 455 ÷ 132

⇒ r ≈ 3.4469...

**∴ The correct answer is 3.45 (Option 4).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area of Cylinder

The total surface area includes the curved surface and the two circular bases: TSA = 2πr(h + r).

Volume of Cylinder

The amount of space occupied by a cylindrical rod is given by: Volume = πr²h.

Hollow Cylinder CSA

For a hollow cylinder with outer radius R and inner radius r, the total curved surface area is 2πh(R + r).

Slant Height of Cone

The slant height (l) of a cone is related to its radius (r) and height (h) as: l = √(r² + h²).
